decisions.reason: As a core cardboard quarter-pallet display aligned with the firm's stated direction, several years of sunk development, sales, and customer-facing commitment make withdrawal unlikely.
This pegboard-backed cardboard display remains close to the established offer, and management would be inclined to justify and continue a long-supported launch rather than reverse course now.
Because the eighth-pallet display broadens the standard display range in a familiar format, it is likely to be retained as part of the firm's committed portfolio.

The wooden display pallet is less central than the cardboard line, but the firm has already invested in extending the display concept beyond its core and would likely persist unless results clearly deteriorate.
Although the media-products variant serves a narrower niche, its close link to the core quarter-pallet offer and the firm's prior commitment still make continued support more likely than withdrawal.
